current.text: Gabe Vincent is not named in Lloyd's expected Atlanta rotation. The projected starters are McCollum, Alexander-Walker, Daniels, Johnson and Okongwu. The expected bench is Dort, Wiggins, Landale, Flemings and probably Newell, with Kispert and Finney-Smith also in the mix.
With no place in the expected 10-man rotation, he is not a draft option in a 12-team league.

durable.text: His projected line is far below the top 250 pool in points, rebounds and steals.

note: Both sites value Vincent at 0 USD. Yahoo ranks him 362nd and ESPN 209th, both outside our 144-player draft pool, so do not draft him. He averaged 16.5 minutes last season and shot 35.2% from the field. Atlanta's expected rotation leaves him out, so only watch him if several Hawks guards get hurt early in the season.
